{{BossList|Default|Ref = Only the first '''Null Scout''' spawned in [[Outpost 16]] as a boss.}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Scout''', internally referred to as '''Corrupted Scout''', was an enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had higher health than every enemy that appeared before it while also being faster than every enemy except the [[Null Runner]]. It can be spawned by the [[Null Commander]], which boosts its [[Defense]] to 50%. ==Logbook Description== "''Scout stared down the Null Scout, and the creature stared back. Scout lifted one arm, and so it mirrored. He lifted the other — Null Scout followed. Scout quickly dropped both arms and aimed his weapons at the creature, who copied it. Then from the side, Trapper threw a landmine behind the Null Scout. Scout grinned, and stepped back — ... and Null Scout followed.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Scout''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Scout]]. It has light pink skin, torn black shirt and pants, and a single knee-pad. It has a few bandages wrapped around its hands. On its head, it wears a black cap and headphones, alongside cracked shades. Its entire body is covered in what appeared to be purple goo. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *The '''Null Scout''' is significantly stronger than every enemy that appeared before it, making it quite tough. **A few tower which worked on previous enemies, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Military Base]] or [[Cowboy]] can be used to deal with this. *As it is quite fast, stalling towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be helpful here. **Do note that when it first spawns, it is a [[Boss]], limiting how many towers can stall it, and it always spawns with the [[Stun Immunity]], meaning it cannot be knocked back and stuns only slow it down. **Most stalling towers are also capable of reducing its [[Defense]], though as it is rather low this will have minimal impact on the damage it receives. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animation Variants}} NullScout1.png|Second animation (18 October 2025 – 25 October 2025) NullScout3.png|Third animation (18 October 2025 – 25 October 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - Halloween 2025 Trailer|'''Null Scout''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Charms}} NullScoutCharm.png| '''Null Scout''' on the [[Null Scout Charm]]. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NullScoutIconIG.png|'''Null Scout''' on its [[Index]] icon. DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Scout''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Null Scout''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Null Scout''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Scout''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Null Scout''' breaks in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *''' 19 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0|v1.77.3a]] **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **Now appears in [[Banlands]]. **{{Bug}} '''Null Scout''' no longer has animation variants. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Scout''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Scout''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ***'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{Outpost16|[[Null Dredge]]|Wave 2|Null Scout|Wave 5|[[Null Crook Boss]]|Wave 7}} {{Banlands|[[Null Dredge]]|Wave 3 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Null Shrieker]]|hardw1 = Wave 5 (Hard)|Null Scout|Wave 6|[[Null Shrieker]]|Wave 7 (Easy)|hardt3 = [[Lost Glitch]]|hardw3 = Wave 8 (Hard)}} {{BlindFaith|Start|N/A|Null Scout & [[Null Dredge]]|Wave 1|[[Null Runner]] & [[Lost Glitch]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
